title: PEEL框架：AI赋能研究中确保认知责任性的符号学支架
summary: 本文提出PEEL框架（Protocols for Epistemically Engaged Literacy in AI），结合Voyant Tools的确定性远读与Claude的LLM解释，基于皮尔斯符号学和溯因推理。应用于AI生成的文本凝练时，揭示了数量、词频和认知声音的系统性失真，并得出三项设计启示：确定性工具必须伴随AI工具；流畅性不等于保真度；认知权威必须被设计而非假设。
summary_en: Introduces PEEL, a scaffolding combining deterministic distant reading (Voyant Tools) with LLM interpretation (Claude), grounded in Peircean semiotics. Applied to AI-generated condensations, it reveals systematic distortions in quantity, term frequency, and epistemic voice, yielding three design implications for accountable AI research.
